title: 相槌
note: 相手のひと言にすぐ返す短い反応。機能（同意・理解・驚き・反対…）ごとに、自分から言う基本の言い方（basic）と、聞いて分かればよい言い方（more）を分ける。答えは相槌＋続きのひと言。文・場面・訳はすべてオリジナル。

decks.title: その通り（同意する）
decks.note: 自分から言うのは基本の3つで十分。Absolutely. は強い同意。That's correct. は事実の確認に。Totally. はくだけた言い方、Certainly. / Indeed. は改まった言い方。

cards.said: So the larger dataset gave you better accuracy?
cards.ja: つまり、データが多いほど精度が上がったのですね？
cards.en: Exactly. The accuracy went up by about five percent.

cards.said: It sounds like collecting the data took a lot of time.
cards.ja: データ集めにはずいぶん時間がかかったようですね。
cards.en: That's right. It took us almost a year.

cards.said: Do you agree that the evaluation needs real users?
cards.ja: 評価には実際のユーザーが必要だと思いますか？
cards.en: Absolutely. That's our next step.

cards.said: Small labs can't easily collect that much data.
cards.ja: 小さな研究室では、それだけのデータは簡単に集められませんね。
cards.en: That's true. That's why we shared our dataset.

cards.said: So you ran each test three times?
cards.ja: では、各テストを3回ずつ行ったのですね？
cards.en: That's correct. We report the average of the three runs.

cards.said: This will be useful for other groups, too.
cards.ja: これは他のグループにも役に立ちそうですね。
cards.en: Definitely. We plan to release the code.

decks.title: 一部は同意する
decks.note: 相手の意見をいったん受け止めてから、but で自分の考えを足す。いきなり No と言うより角が立たない。
basic: I see what you mean, but ...
more: I agree up to a point.

cards.said: Your sample is too small to say anything.
cards.ja: サンプルが小さすぎて、何も言えないのでは。
cards.en: That's a good point, but the trend was the same in every group.

cards.said: Deep learning would surely work better here.
cards.ja: ここはディープラーニングの方がきっとうまくいきますよ。
cards.en: I see what you mean, but our data was too small for it.

cards.said: Lab results never hold in the real world.
cards.ja: 実験室の結果は、現実では通用しませんよ。
cards.en: That's true to some extent. That's why we also ran a field study.

cards.said: The new method is just slower.
cards.ja: 新しい手法は遅いだけですね。
cards.en: You have a point, but it's much more accurate.

cards.said: More features always help.
cards.ja: 特徴量は多いほど良いですよね。
cards.en: I agree up to a point, but too many can cause overfitting.

cards.said: You should have used a public dataset.
cards.ja: 公開データセットを使うべきでしたね。
cards.en: That's a good point, but none of them had the labels we needed.

decks.title: 分かった（同意ではない）
decks.note: 話を理解したという合図で、賛成の意味はない。批判を聞いている途中で Yes, yes や Right, right と言うと、認めたように聞こえる。聞いているだけなら I see. / Mm-hm. にする。

cards.said: Our server crashed, so we lost a week of data.
cards.ja: サーバーが落ちて、1週間分のデータを失ったんです。
cards.en: I see. That must have been hard.

cards.said: The deadline was moved to next Friday.
cards.ja: 締め切りは来週の金曜に変わりました。
cards.en: Got it. I'll send my slides by Thursday.

cards.said: We normalize the data first because the sensors are different.
cards.ja: センサーが違うので、まずデータを正規化しています。
cards.en: That makes sense. Otherwise the scales wouldn't match.

cards.said: I think your baseline is too weak, so the comparison isn't fair.
cards.ja: ベースラインが弱すぎて、比較が公平でないと思います。
cards.en: I see. Which baseline would you suggest?

cards.said: You need to book the room through the office.
cards.ja: 部屋は事務室を通して予約する必要があります。
cards.en: I understand. I'll ask them today.

cards.said: First you choose the file, and then you press run.
cards.ja: まずファイルを選んで、それから実行を押します。
cards.en: OK, I follow. And then the results appear here?

decks.title: 驚く・興味を示す
decks.note: Really? は上げ調子で「本当に？」。Interesting. は話を広げる合図で、続けて質問すると自然。No way! はくだけた言い方なので学会では避ける。

cards.said: Our model runs on a phone in real time.
cards.ja: 私たちのモデルはスマホでリアルタイムに動きます。
cards.en: Really? How much battery does it use?

cards.said: We found that people walk faster in the morning.
cards.ja: 人は朝の方が速く歩くことが分かりました。
cards.en: Interesting. Do you know why?

cards.said: Only ten percent of the users opened the app twice.
cards.ja: アプリを2回開いたユーザーは1割だけでした。
cards.en: That's surprising. I expected more.

cards.said: This conference started with only twenty people.
cards.ja: この学会は、たった20人で始まったんですよ。
cards.en: Oh, I didn't know that. It's so big now.

cards.said: We collected data from over a thousand people.
cards.ja: 千人以上からデータを集めました。
cards.en: That's impressive. How long did it take?

cards.said: Some participants wore the sensor upside down.
cards.ja: センサーを逆さまに付けていた参加者もいました。
cards.en: Really? Could you still use their data?

decks.title: 考える時間をつなぐ
decks.note: 黙り込むより、ひと言つないでから考える。Well, は文頭に置いて少し間を取る。That's a good question. は考える時間を稼ぐ定番。
more: Hmm, how can I put it?

cards.said: Which part was the hardest?
cards.ja: どの部分がいちばん大変でしたか？
cards.en: Let me see. Probably the labeling.

cards.said: Why didn't you try a larger model?
cards.ja: なぜもっと大きなモデルを試さなかったのですか？
cards.en: Well, our data was quite small.

cards.said: How would this work for children?
cards.ja: 子どもだとどうなりますか？
cards.en: That's a good question. We haven't tested it yet.

cards.said: What would you do differently next time?
cards.ja: 次は何を変えますか？
cards.en: Let me think. I would collect more data first.

cards.said: How is your method different from theirs?
cards.ja: あなたの手法は、彼らのものとどう違うのですか？
cards.en: Hmm, how can I put it? Ours needs much less data.

cards.said: What was the most surprising result?
cards.ja: いちばん意外だった結果は何ですか？
cards.en: Good question. The results at night, I think.

decks.title: 丁寧に反対する
decks.note: 反対するときは、やわらげる言葉を付ける。I don't think so. は直接的なので、まず I'm not sure about that. や I see it a bit differently. を使う。Actually, … は事実を訂正するときに便利。
basic: I see it a bit differently.

cards.said: Your results are only true for young people.
cards.ja: あなたの結果は、若い人にしか当てはまりませんね。
cards.en: I'm not sure about that. Our oldest participant was seventy.

cards.said: Accuracy is the only thing that matters.
cards.ja: 大事なのは精度だけです。
cards.en: I see it a bit differently. Speed matters too.

cards.said: This method can't be used outside the lab.
cards.ja: この手法は実験室の外では使えません。
cards.en: I'm afraid I disagree. We tested it at home, too.

cards.said: So you had ten participants?
cards.ja: では、参加者は10人だったのですね？
cards.en: Actually, we had twelve.

cards.said: Everyone already knows this result.
cards.ja: この結果は、もう誰でも知っていますよ。
cards.en: I'm not so sure. No one has measured it this way.

cards.said: One sensor is never enough.
cards.ja: センサー1つでは絶対に足りません。
cards.en: I'm not sure about that. One was enough for most activities.

decks.title: 否定の質問に答える
decks.note: 英語では質問の形に関係なく、答えの中身が肯定なら Yes、否定なら No。日本語の「はい、使っていません」は No, we didn't. になる。Yes / No のあとに中身を続けると誤解されない。

cards.said: Didn't you use a control group?
cards.ja: 対照群は使わなかったのですか？（使わなかった）
cards.en: No, we didn't. We compared before and after instead.

cards.said: Isn't the sensor too heavy?
cards.ja: センサーは重すぎませんか？（重くない）
cards.en: No, it isn't. It weighs only twenty grams.

cards.said: Don't you need more participants?
cards.ja: もっと参加者が必要ではないですか？（必要だ）
cards.en: Yes, we do. We're recruiting more now.

cards.said: Doesn't it work at night?
cards.ja: 夜は動かないのですか？（動く）
cards.en: Yes, it does. It works just as well at night.

cards.said: Haven't you published this yet?
cards.ja: まだ発表していないのですか？（まだしていない）
cards.en: No, not yet. We're writing the paper now.

cards.said: Aren't you worried about privacy?
cards.ja: プライバシーは心配ではないですか？（心配している）
cards.en: Yes, we are. That's why we don't record audio.
